title: The French president is commander-in-chief of the armed forces
summary: The French president is commander-in-chief of the armed forces.
body: Article 15 says the president is commander-in-chief of the armed forces and presides over the higher national defence councils and committees. The source says: "Advisory bodies to the head of state , Designation of commander in chief ARTICLE 15 The President of the Republic shall be Commander-in-Chief of the Armed Forces." Article 21, separately, says the prime minister is responsible for national defence. The constitution states both sentences. This card is the presidential sentence.

sources.title: Constitution of 4 October 1958, Constitute Project English text
